prompt: A jacket costs $\$80$. First a coupon takes $25\%$ off. Then $10\%$ tax is added to the new price. What is the final price in dollars?
hint: Two machines in a row: the discount machine runs FIRST, then the tax machine.

hints.text: Two machines in a row: the discount machine runs FIRST, then the tax machine.
$25\%$ off means you pay $75\%$: $0.75 \times 80 = 60$. Now add $10\%$ tax to $\$60$.
Tax: $1.1 \times 60 = 66$, so the final price is $\$66$.

alternativeExplanations.title: One receipt at a time
steps: Sticker price: $\$80$. The coupon takes off $\$20$ (a quarter of 80).
The tax line adds $\$6$, so the total you hand over is $\$66$.
